bbdInsights.title: bbdInsights
bbdInsights.description: Operational banking insights including applications, pipeline, approvals, and drawdowns; each record belongs to a specific customer and must not be mixed across customers unless in PORTFOLIO scope.

customerAndWocInsights.title: customerAndWocInsights
customerAndWocInsights.description: Combined financial and behavioral insights per customer including balances, utilisation, risk, propensity, and opportunity signals; must be filtered to one customer in SINGLE scope and can include all in PORTFOLIO scope.
